principles: No koala token a user would set/read may remain in the env layer
Rename setters and readers together to keep the runtime contract whole
Touch only env vars — not LEGACY_KOALA_* path constants or recorded history
Prove completion with a residual scan reaching zero, not by inspection
drivers: Open-source launch must not ship unexplainable KOALA_* env vars
No external users yet, so a hard break with no fallback is acceptable
build + e2e must stay green throughout

options.name: Hard eliminate (chosen)
cons: Breaking for any external KOALA_ exporter

options.name: Transitional dual-read
cons: Leaves KOALA_ tokens in code — violates the goal

options.name: Rename user-facing subset only
cons: Residual KOALA_ still hard to explain

rationale: A dual-read shim would leave KOALA_ in code, defeating the no-KOALA_ OSS goal; with no external users a clean break is safe and avoids carrying dead compat into the public release.

preMortem.scenario: A KOALA_ env SETTER (Codex/hook/subprocess wrapper) is missed while its reader is renamed
preMortem.trigger: Rename driven only by process.env reads, ignoring assignment sites and string literals in .Codex/.claude/bin/docs
preMortem.consequence: The renamed reader sees undefined at runtime; hooks/subprocess context silently loses its value
preMortem.mitigation: Rename setters and readers per-var together; grep assignments and bare 'KOALA_X' literals across assets+docs; residual scan over .Codex/.claude/bin/docs must hit zero

preMortem.scenario: Dropping a twin's `|| KOALA_X` fallback breaks a path that relied on KOALA_X being exported (no LATTICE_X set)
preMortem.trigger: Assuming every twin's LATTICE_X is always populated
preMortem.consequence: A code path that only had KOALA_PROJECT_ROOT/etc. now resolves to a wrong default
preMortem.mitigation: For each of the 17 twins confirm the LATTICE_X read is the tested path; run full e2e + affected smokes after the drop

preMortem.scenario: A blanket sed rewrites LEGACY_KOALA_* path constants or .koala tokens
preMortem.trigger: Global koala->lattice replace without excluding the deferred path-compat layer
preMortem.consequence: Corrupts the .koala path-compat constants and the legacy activity-log path
preMortem.mitigation: Exclude core/lattice-paths.ts LEGACY_KOALA_* and any '.koala' token; concept reviewer greps for over-reach; build must pass

preMortem.scenario: A recorded historical fixture gating a smoke test gets its KOALA_ rewritten
preMortem.trigger: Treating recorded past-run data the same as current-name assertions
preMortem.consequence: Falsifies replayed history or breaks the gate
preMortem.mitigation: Update only current-name test assertions, not recorded historical fixtures; run the gated smokes
